$generated.description: A marketing/landing site footer: a required brand { name:{it,en}, optional brandIcon name-token from an owned enum resolved internally, optional tagline:{it,en} } + a required non-empty columns[] (each { heading:{it,en}, links:[{ label:{it,en}, href }] }) + an optional social[] (each { icon name-token from an owned enum resolved internally, href, label:{it,en} }) + a required bottom { copyright:{it,en}, optional legalLinks:[{ label:{it,en}, href }] }; all text is {it,en}. It has a two-view: the narrow view collapses each link column into a keyboard-operable Radix Accordion disclosure (links hidden until its heading is activated), the wide view is an always-open multi-column grid with every link visible; the bottom is a hairline legal bar. No prop carries raw code.

a11y: The narrow-view link columns are real, keyboard-operable disclosures built on Radix Accordion (type="multiple", so each column opens and closes independently and none is forced open): each column heading is a native <button> Accordion.Trigger with an accessible name resolved from its {it,en} heading, exposing aria-expanded (false while collapsed, true while expanded) and aria-controls to its links region; it is reachable by Tab, activated by Enter/Space, moved between with arrow keys, and carries a visible focus-visible ring (ring-ring offset from the background) legible in both themes. A column's links are hidden (not in the accessibility tree) until its heading is activated. On the wide view the same columns are an always-open multi-column grid with a static <h3> heading and every link visible, no disclosure.

Only the container-width branch is in layout: the narrow accordion is display:none at the wide width and the wide grid is display:none at the narrow width, so a screen reader / axe never double-counts the columns or announces both branches. Both branches render from the SAME declared columns.

Every declared link, legal link, and social link is a real anchor (<a href>), keyboard-operable and reachable by Tab in DOM order, activating on Enter and navigating to its declared href, each with the same visible focus-visible ring. Each social link carries an accessible name from its {it,en} label (via aria-label) while its lucide glyph is DECORATIVE (aria-hidden), and the accordion open/closed state and the link hover/active affordance are carried by aria-expanded, shape, position, and the revealed links, never by colour alone, so they stay distinguishable to a colour-blind or monochrome viewer.

One <footer> landmark (nav-free) hosts the whole surface as the AA-verified solid bg-background / text-foreground pairing; secondary and link text uses text-muted-foreground with the accent-driven --accent-ink hover, section and bottom-bar separators are the hairline border-border / border-t dividers, so axe A/AA (text and non-text contrast) is clean in BOTH themes on the wide grid AND on the narrow footer with a column expanded.
forbidden: No raw HTML/code or SVG string in any prop and no dangerouslySetInnerHTML: every text field (brand name, brand tagline, each column heading, each link label, each social label, the copyright, each legal link label) is an {it,en} plain string, each link is exactly { label:{it,en}, href }, so a declaration can never inject markup, a script, or an icon/graphic as a code or ReactNode slot.

The brand and social icons are name-tokens only: brandIcon and each social[].icon are the owned iconNameSchema enum resolved internally to a lucide component, and an icon given as a raw SVG/HTML string or an arbitrary name outside the enum is a contract error (InvalidComponentPropsError), never a rendered graphic; there is no other prop through which a declaration supplies its own icon or graphic.

No hardcoded hue or hex/rgb/hsl/oklch literal and no arbitrary spacing/radius bracket: colour comes only from the accent-driven and semantic tokens (bg-background / text-foreground / text-muted-foreground / border-border / --accent-ink / ring-ring), and spacing/radius use only named scale steps (px-*/py-*/gap-*/pt-*/pb-*/size-*/rounded-*), never a fixed value or a [13px]-style bracket; the dividers are the border-border hairline, not a raw colour or width.

No newsletter/subscribe form and no language-switcher control in the footer, and no forced-open column prop: the two-view is a container-query structural change (an always-open multi-column grid vs collapsible accordion columns), the narrow columns' open/closed state is internal Radix Accordion state, and there is no prop that supplies nested menus, collapse markup, a form field, or forces a column open.
